title: Levothyroxine replacement therapy for primary hypothyroidism
text: Levothyroxine, a synthetic form of thyroxine, restores euthyroid status in patients with primary hypothyroidism by replacing deficient endogenous thyroid hormone. Dosing is titrated according to serum thyroid-stimulating hormone levels, with periodic monitoring required to avoid iatrogenic hyperthyroidism.
